The Daman & Diu State Co-operative Bank Ltd. (DDSCBL) has released an official notification inviting applications for the recruitment of one Cooperative Intern for Diu District on a one-year contract basis. This engagement is carried out under the directions of NABARD and the National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) scheme.

Vacancy and Important Details

  • Issuing Authority: The Daman & Diu State Co-operative Bank Ltd., Head Office, Nani Daman
  • Notification ID / Reference: Not specified
  • Post Name: Cooperative Intern
  • Total Vacancies: 1 (Diu District)
  • Duration: One year (Purely temporary internship, not an employment offer)
  • Remuneration: Consolidated Rs. 25,000 per month (TA/DA paid separately by the bank)
  • Application Fee: Not specified

Eligibility Criteria

  • Age Limit: Candidates must be between 21 and 30 years old.
  • Educational Qualification: MBA or equivalent degree in Marketing Management, Cooperative Management, Agri Business Management, or Rural Development Management, along with essential computer proficiency.

Important Dates & Application Process

  • Application Mode: Offline (via post or hand delivery)
  • Last Date to Apply: 23 November 2026 by 05:00 PM
  • Selection Stages: Not specified in the available notice details.
  • Result / Admit Card / Answer Key Status: Not applicable / Not specified

Interested eligible candidates must prepare their application on plain paper with complete bio-data, enclosing self-attested copies of certificates for age, eligibility, educational qualifications, and experience, along with a recent colored passport-size photograph.

Postal Address for Submission: The General Manager (ADM), The Daman & Diu State Cooperative Bank Ltd., Head Office- H. No. 14/54, 1st Floor, Dilipnagar, Nani Daman - 396210

Verification and Official Notice

Applicants are strongly advised to check the official bank website to review the full notification and NABARD's circular dated 15.03.2024 before submitting applications. Ensure that all submissions reach the designated address before the strict deadline of 5:00 PM on November 23, 2026, as late applications will be rejected outright.
